about.label: About
about.title: Code that holds up over time.
about.lead: Fullstack developer with real product experience. I'm comfortable on both sides: from the data model to the last detail of the interface.
about.subtitle: A little about me
about.text1: I'm a fullstack developer with experience in JavaScript/TypeScript and Java. I've built SaaS platforms, marketplaces and booking systems that are running in production today.
about.text2: I care about the decisions you don't see: modelling data properly, setting clear boundaries between modules and leaving code someone else can follow. Then the front end has to feel fast and considered.
about.cap1Text: APIs with Node and NestJS, PostgreSQL and Prisma modelling, integrations and business logic.
about.cap2Text: React, Next.js and Tailwind with a focus on performance, accessibility and visual consistency.
about.cap3Text: Socket.IO and Ably for live events; Retell AI and React Flow for conversational agents.
about.cap4Text: From repository to production, with clear communication, reviewable handoffs and follow-through after launch.
about.text3: Then the front end needs to feel fast, predictable and visually considered, with zero friction for end users and business operators.
